mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine, Alaska; 30% owned via Peak Gold JV (Kinross 70%, operator/manager); ore trucked to Kinross Fort Knox for toll processing. FY2025 (100% basis): 1,069,000 tons processed @ 0.20 oz/ton Au, 93% recovery, ~198,500 oz recovered. Contango 30% share: ~59,500 oz produced; 57,800 oz Au and 57,315 oz Ag sold; total gold sales $196.7M at avg realized $3,400/oz (14,061 oz at spot, 43,739 oz into hedges; 43,000 oz hedged remaining). Cash distributions received $102.0M. Cash cost $1,459/oz sold, AISC $1,616/oz sold (by-product basis). 2026 guidance: 70,000-75,000 oz at $1,500-$1,600/oz; 2027: 75,000-80,000 oz at $1,200-$1,300/oz. Grade 0.20 oz/ton = 6.86 g/t. No reserve table disclosed in 10-K (field null).

notes: 10-K used (year ended December 31, 2025, filed March 16, 2026; CIK 1502377). Fiscal year-end changed to December 31 (prior FY ended June 30). Production = attributable ounces (30% JV share). All amounts in USD.
